annotations.title: Check your Factline watches for alerts (free)

description: Free. Use at the start of a session or on a schedule when the user has Factline watches (from watch_30_days or a key): lists the watches and any alerts (a new sanctions match, a company status, name or address change, APK or recall change). Input: token (wt_..., returned by watch_30_days) or api_key, optional since (YYYY-MM-DD).

since.description: Only alerts after this date, YYYY-MM-DD
